outlook: The Indian market witnessed a negative close with NIFTY 50 and SENSEX both down, indicating a bearish sentiment. While the IT sector showed remarkable strength, led by Infosys, severe selling pressure was observed in the Auto sector. Overall market breadth remained weak with more declining stocks.
keyTakeaways: NIFTY 50 and SENSEX closed lower by -0.88% and -0.79% respectively.

NIFTY AUTO was the biggest laggard, plummeting -3.46%, led by BAJAJ-AUTO.NS (-7.6%) and MARUTI.NS (-4.9%).
